note: 30-acre family campground in the cottonwoods on a bend of the Highwood River near De Winton, 20 minutes southeast of Calgary; gravel roads, river floating and beach access. Many sites are tent-only or for tent trailers and short trailers; check the posted site length. Monthly sites are also sold. --Claude
summary: Read operator pages and the PitchCamp engine (2027 dates): base C$47 (20 A water/power) confirmed, full service C$55, riverfront site 127 C$75 (new high), C$10 reservation fee, extra adult C$10; electric 30, sewer, dump; season Apr 15-Oct 15 confirmed; booking PitchCamp; max listed site 35 ft. GOOGLE 3.5 from 509 reviews = drop candidate under the under-4.0 rule; riverfront recommended down to riverview (only site 127 tagged riverfront, tree fringe on the bank).
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (reviews, AWH 2026-11-02 rule: a private park under 4.0 on Google with 25+ reviews is a drop unless it has an --AWH note; no --AWH note here): Google Maps 3.5 from 509 reviews (listing 'Nature's Hideaway Family Campground', +1 403-938-8185, naturesfamilycampground.com). RV Life stored 4 stars, $$.
PRICE GATE (private): base C$47 (RV water and power 20 A, 2 adults) + GST; full service C$55; riverfront site C$75; well under C$69. gateways.py: Calgary (metro) 33 km.
PRESENCE: https://www.naturesfamilycampground.com/ and /rates answered 200 (Wix), phone 1.403.938.8185 (matches stored); PitchCamp engine live (2027 nights for sale). Ownership private correct.

LONG STAY (monthly rates posted: 'WATER / POWER SITE (20 amp) ... $1,185 / 1 month', full service '$1,385 / 1 month'): test 1 pass - nights sold online; test 2 pass - nightly rates posted, minimum 2 nights on regular weekends / 3 on long weekends only; test 3/4 borderline - for one night on opening day 2027 (Apr 15-16) PitchCamp offered 54 'stays', but only about 16 were RV sites (9, 10, 16, 30, 30A, 32, 46, 50, 60, 80, 83, 101, 114, 127, Z1, Z2) while site numbers run to 127+; the rest were letter-named tent sites. So roughly 1 RV site in 8 is sold nightly online - just over the 1-in-10 line, and the rest of the numbered sites are not offered (probably monthly/seasonal holders); test 5 pass - not a home community. I read it as a park with a large monthly/long-stay share, not mostly seasonal by its own wording.

FIT: RV sites offered list 'Fits: Max' 22-35 ft (site 60 is 22 ft; 30, 30A, 32, 46, 50, 80, 127, Z1, Z2 take 26-35 ft); several letter sites are capped at 18, 21, 25 or 27-ft trailers with no slide-outs. A 23-ft rig fits about nine of the sites offered.

WATERFRONT (stored riverfront - recommend riverview): the Highwood here is ~45-50 m wide (river). On imagery the campground fills a point bar inside a bend; the easternmost row of units is ~12-22 m from the east bank but behind a single line of bank cottonwoods, and the south-east units look onto an open sand/gravel beach ~25-40 m wide; the north side has the access road between sites and river. The engine tags exactly ONE site as waterfront: '127 RV OR TENT - Riverfront - FULL SERVICE' (30 ft, C$75); every other RV site is untagged. One named site is not 'a few', and the imagery does not show open ground from the RV rows to the water, so riverfront is unearned: recommend riverview (river visible through the bank trees from the east row). If AWH counts one tagged site, it stays riverfront with a caveat naming site 127.

PIN (50.80855,-113.78148): at the entrance where the access road reaches the campground; the RV area centre is ~150 m SE (about 50.8077,-113.7800). Google 50.80785,-113.78075 is ~95 m from the pin. Within tolerance, no move.
SEASON: water shut off Oct 4 per the engine banner ('WATER IS SHUT OFF OCTOBER 4TH'); the home page says 'Water services are available from thaw to freeze up.'
